text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged. Their primary benefit is catching bugs early, which saves significant time and money compared to fixing issues after release. Beyond finding errors, reviews are an excellent tool for knowledge sharing; developers learn new techniques and understand different parts of the project. This process also boosts overall team quality by encouraging consistent standards and clearer, more maintainable code. When everyone participates respectfully, code reviews become less about criticism and more about collaborative improvement, leading to a stronger, more confident team.
